events.title: Imagine album turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine album anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. That timeless title track still resonates, doesn't it? What's your favourite lyric from the album?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, born Gordon Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's 75th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to Sting! From The Police to his solo career, he's given us so many classics. Which Sting track are you playing to celebrate?

events.title: The first iPod was released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer. Suddenly, your entire music collection fit in your pocket. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your definitive 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. So much music, so many iconic tracks. If you had to pick just one song from it, what would it be?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's the Queen song that always gets you?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showcased their evolving sound. Which track from it is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace remain as powerful as ever. What's the Lennon song that resonates most with you today?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary artist David Bowie.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His impact on music is immeasurable. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are legendary. What's the ultimate Page guitar moment for you?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to classic crooning, he's done it all. What's your favourite Rod Stewart song?
